summary: ADR-0060 accepted 2026-08-18; v1 Skill-input remains historical and cannot auto-promote to v2 authority; v2 assigns candidate roles: normative_source, authority_source, implementation_input, lifecycle_projection, derived_context, execution_evidence, report, ephemeral_attempt; only first three authorize; compute separate sourceSelectionHash and sourceContentHash; selection binds roles, relative paths, modules, scope, resources, content binds selected bytes; adapter owns transport, pages, continuation validity, coverage, truncation and must not summarize proven-complete coverage as truncated; publish ready receipts only as immutable generations under skill-input-generations/<binding-hash>/; atomically advance validated non-authorizing current pointer; consumers use pointer only, never mtimes, suffixes, scans; execution/publication/semantic-review gates independent; derive Knowledge self-change from changed-set and canonical path policy, not caller flag; attempts require leases/heartbeats; retention protects current pointer, lifecycle/authorization/terminal references, active unexpired attempts; committed evidence deletion needs maintainer approval plus non-authorizing cleanup receipt; migrate all consumers before 8-18 can create new current receipt; existing skill-input-current* directories remain immutable historical evidence pending approved retention; ADR extends 0048, 0050, 0057, 0058, 0059 and supersedes only their v1 selection/current-resolution practices; does not create lifecycle authority, publish Knowledge, or start Bootstrap
